rows.label: TASK:Evidence Investigation
rows.definition: Researches, diagnoses, compares, mines, triages analytically, or synthesizes evidence.

rows.label: TASK:Artifact Change
rows.definition: Creates, edits, repairs, removes, translates, or otherwise changes a durable project artifact.

rows.label: TASK:Artifact Review
rows.definition: Judges an existing artifact or proposal and returns findings, approval, or critique against criteria.

rows.label: TASK:Executable Validation
rows.definition: Executes a test, build, benchmark, lint, protocol, or explicit behavioral check.

rows.label: TASK:Work Item Management
rows.definition: Changes work-item lifecycle, ownership, routing, or metadata.

rows.label: OUTPUT:Control Signal
rows.definition: Requires a status-only or control result such as noop, label, close, approval, or dispatch.

rows.label: OUTPUT:New Thread
rows.definition: Requires a newly created issue or discussion as the primary published result.

rows.label: OUTPUT:Existing Thread Response
rows.definition: Requires a response attached to an existing issue, PR, review, or discussion.

rows.label: OUTPUT:Repository Change
rows.definition: Requires a persistent repository or release change, such as a commit, PR, merge, or release update.

rows.label: OUTPUT:Standalone Artifact
rows.definition: Requires a standalone report, file, diagram, chart, archive, or upload.

rows.label: CONSTRAINT:Scope Boundary
rows.definition: Limits allowed files, repositories, actions, targets, change size, or writable surfaces.

rows.label: CONSTRAINT:Quality Standard
rows.definition: Prescribes clarity, precision, concision, formatting quality, or completeness.

rows.label: CONSTRAINT:Resource Budget
rows.definition: Caps time, attempts, files, issues, tokens, cost, depth, or another consumable resource.

rows.label: CONSTRAINT:Evidence Grounding
rows.definition: Requires claims to be supported by evidence or prohibits speculation.

rows.label: PROCESS:Required Sequence
rows.definition: Defines a mandatory order of stages or prerequisites.

rows.label: PROCESS:Decision Branch
rows.definition: Defines a decision, gate, fallback, stopping condition, or error path.

rows.label: PROCESS:Within-Run Iteration
rows.definition: Defines within-run loops, batches, retries, round-robin selection, or multiple passes.

rows.label: PROCESS:Cross-Run Memory
rows.definition: Reads, writes, or advances persistent state across runs.

rows.label: PROCESS:Work Delegation
rows.definition: Transfers substantive work to a subagent, worker, skill, handler, or dispatched workflow.

rows.label: RESOURCE:GitHub Interface
rows.definition: Directs use of GitHub APIs, MCP tools, gh, repository search, or GitHub object data.

rows.label: RESOURCE:Local Workspace
rows.definition: Directs use of local files, shell commands, source, logs, scripts, or references.

rows.label: RESOURCE:Agent Resource
rows.definition: Directs use of subagents, reusable skills, model calls, or agent/memory services.

rows.label: RESOURCE:Development Toolchain
rows.definition: Directs use of compilers, tests, linters, benchmarks, analyzers, or build systems.

rows.label: RESOURCE:Web Retrieval
rows.definition: Directs use of websites, web search, feeds, provider documentation, or external services.

rows.label: CONTEXT:Repository Context
rows.definition: Supplies facts about a repository, PR, issue, release, commit, branch, or trigger.

rows.label: CONTEXT:Domain Context
rows.definition: Supplies subject-matter knowledge, business rules, standards, protocols, or project concepts.

rows.label: CONTEXT:Execution Environment
rows.definition: Supplies runtime, operating-system, sandbox, path, software, or precomputed-input facts.

rows.label: CONTEXT:Historical Context
rows.definition: Supplies prior runs, baselines, cached findings, releases, or earlier decisions.

rows.label: EVALUATION:Rule Conformance
rows.definition: Judges whether an artifact satisfies a rubric, specification, convention, or acceptance criterion.

rows.label: EVALUATION:Risk Assessment
rows.definition: Judges severity, confidence, impact, exploitability, blast radius, or priority.

rows.label: EVALUATION:Execution Check
rows.definition: Judges whether code builds, tests pass, a service responds, or a protocol behaves as expected.

rows.label: EVALUATION:Evidence Credibility
rows.definition: Judges the reliability, authority, completeness, or corroboration of evidence.

rows.label: EXAMPLE:Output Template
rows.definition: Provides a fill-in output skeleton, report schema, section layout, or response scaffold.

rows.label: EXAMPLE:Technical Snippet
rows.definition: Provides sample code, command, query, JSON, Mermaid, or configuration.

rows.label: EXAMPLE:Worked Case
rows.definition: Provides a worked positive, negative, edge, or counterexample illustrating a decision.

rows.label: COMMUNICATION:Expert Role
rows.definition: Assigns a professional role or specialist identity that materially frames judgment.

rows.label: COMMUNICATION:Automation Disclosure
rows.definition: Requires output to reveal automation, limitations, uncertainty, or a non-human role.

rows.label: COMMUNICATION:Audience Voice
rows.definition: Specifies audience, language, tone, politeness, enthusiasm, or communication style.

rows.label: SAFETY:Execution Isolation
rows.definition: Addresses sandboxing, filesystem/network boundaries, permissions, or read-only execution.

rows.label: SAFETY:Prompt Injection Defense
rows.definition: Addresses prompt injection, untrusted content, instruction hierarchy, or embedded instructions.

rows.label: SAFETY:Information Confidentiality
rows.definition: Addresses secrets, credentials, tokens, private data, or sensitive-information disclosure.

rows.label: SAFETY:Vulnerability Handling
rows.definition: Addresses discovering, assessing, remediating, or reporting exploitable weaknesses.
